moments.action: A knot of men in leather jackets and women in going-out clothes push through the crowded parking garage. The camera tightens until the long-haired man in the pale jacket and the leather-jacket man lead the pack past the parked cars.
The young man in the red-and-white beanie plays up to a ring of laughing girls, then the camera whip-pans off him across the garage, landing on a woman walking past a white van and the tuning bays.
The beanie guy is still working the girls when the shot cuts away: the leather-jacket man strides up the aisle between the parked cars straight at camera, and a whip-pan carries the garage past.

The man in the grey tee and the beanie guy stand with the dark-haired woman, who looks away. A wide reveals the leather-jacket man and his crew fronting them; the long-haired man in the pale jacket watches, faintly amused.

Over the grey-tee man's shoulder, the spiky-haired man presses his cheek to the woman's to needle him. The grey-tee man squares up and answers; by the last shot the woman has turned to speak to him herself.
The leather-jacket crew close in behind, one of them carrying a metal bar, while the grey-tee man holds his ground face to face with the spiky-haired man.

The standoff holds: the spiky-haired man keeps the woman pinned cheek to cheek and taunts across her while the grey-tee man stares back. It ends wide, the beanie guy craning up at the gathering crowd.

One long held take on the argument: the spiky-haired man grins beside the woman, then leans in until he and the grey-tee man are nose to nose with her caught between them, her eyes flicking from one to the other.
The long-haired man in the pale jacket smirks at the spectacle; the woman cuts in and speaks up herself, and the beanie guy swings through frame in a blur.
The spiky-haired man nuzzles the woman again; the grey-tee man rounds on the beanie guy beside him instead. The spiky man laughs into her hair, and the two outsiders end up staring off together.
The woman turns to the smiling spiky-haired man, the camera blurs past a head, and the shot settles on the leather-jacket crew talking at the long-haired man in the pale jacket.
The grey-tee man and the beanie guy watch, stone-faced. The woman slides her arms around the spiky-haired man and they lock eyes; the grey-tee man finally shouts something back.
